Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。” / Formula: 喜欢 + 在 + place + V.; 装 + V. usually means “pretend to do something,” while “play at doing something” is 玩 + V. / Correct: “孟子和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩，玩祭拜的游戏。” You can also say: “孟子和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里模仿大人祭拜。”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。” / Formula: Subject + 跟/和 + person + 一起 + V. + object; for a completed move, 搬家 + 了 / Correct: “孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈一起搬家了。”
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多” / Formula: 搬家 is a completed event, so use 搬了家; 玩得太多 is understandable, but 贪玩/总是玩 is more natural for a child’s habit / Correct: “他们搬家不是因为孟子太贪玩，而是因为妈妈认为他们家离墓地太近。”

items.reason: “玩在墓地里” has the place phrase in the wrong position, and “装祭拜” needs a fuller expression of pretending to worship.
This is a completed move in the story, so “搬家了” correctly marks completion; “一起” is also acceptable.
The corrected sentence still says “他们搬家” rather than marking the completed event as “他们搬了家.”
